board_roster_reviewed: At listing nine directors: Wang Lei (Chairman, ED), Luo Yin (ED/CEO), Qu Baoyu (ED), Cao Jia (ED/CTO), Zhang Xina (ED) - all management/founders, no investor link disclosed; Zhou Jun (NED, appointed Sept 2020, re-designated NED June 2025) - executive general manager of Shenzhen Capital Group Co., Ltd. (SCGC), a Series C Pre-IPO Investor -> LINKED; Xu Huansheng, Gu Fenling, Jiang Xianling (INEDs, appointed Feb 2023) - academic/corporate backgrounds, no investor link.
rights_and_timing: Seat: Zhou Jun (NED) is an SCGC senior executive and was appointed director in September 2020, i.e. two months after SCGC's Series C investment (July 30, 2020); he sits on the Board at listing. The prospectus does not use the word 'nominated' for him, so the link is via employment/representative status of an identified pre-IPO investor (SCGC). Observer right: Pre-IPO Investors had a right to appoint a board observer (exercised before termination) and an information right; no holder of an observer seat is named. All special rights terminated on the day before the first filing (June 2025) and, if reinstated, cease again on Listing; the non-executive director seat itself is a seat (not a right) and continues after listing.
